LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_FIVE.lessonTitleEnglish: Get on the Internet with a Cell Phone
LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_FIVE.titleTraditional: 量出一個動作做了多久
LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_FIVE.learnerPromise: Say how long an action lasts.
LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_FIVE.explanation: Duration follows the action. With some activities that pair an action word with a thing, Chinese repeats the action word or uses duration + 的 before the thing.

lessonWorld.title: Measure the whole journey
lessonWorld.prompt: The group waits ten minutes and visits for three hours.
lessonWorld.traditional: 我們排隊排十分鐘，參觀三個小時。
lessonWorld.simplified: 我们排队排十分钟，参观三个小时。
lessonWorld.pinyin: Wǒmen páiduì pái shí fēnzhōng, cānguān sān ge xiǎoshí.
lessonWorld.english: We wait in line for ten minutes and visit for three hours.

items.question: I slept three hours. Can I say 我睡覺三個小時?
items.answer: No. A two-part action word needs its first part again: 睡了三個小時的覺 (or 睡覺睡三個小時).

right.pinyin: Wǒ shuì le sān ge xiǎoshí de jiào.
right.english: I slept for three hours.

items.question: Why does 睡 repeat AFTER 睡覺, not inside it?
items.answer: For duration, repeat the first action word after the whole word: 睡覺睡十分鐘. 睡睡覺 would mean “sleep a bit” — not a count of time.

right.english: I sleep for ten minutes.

items.question: I study Chinese for three hours. Where does the time go?
items.answer: With a thing after the action, use duration + 的 + thing: 學三個小時的中文.

right.pinyin: Wǒ xué sān ge xiǎoshí de Zhōngwén.
right.english: I study Chinese for three hours.

discoveryLab.title: Attach the clock to the action
discoveryLab.description: Start with the simplest shape, then watch what happens when the activity also names a thing.

choices.label: Work
choices.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān gōngzuò bā ge xiǎoshí.
choices.english: I work eight hours every day.
choices.note: A simple action can take duration directly.

choices.label: Sleep
choices.traditional: 我每天睡覺睡七個小時。
choices.simplified: 我每天睡觉睡七个小时。
choices.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān shuìjiào shuì qī ge xiǎoshí.
choices.english: I sleep seven hours every day.
choices.note: The action word from 睡覺 repeats before the duration.

choices.label: Class
choices.traditional: 我明天要上課上三個小時。
choices.simplified: 我明天要上课上三个小时。
choices.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān yào shàngkè shàng sān ge xiǎoshí.
choices.english: I will attend class for three hours tomorrow.
choices.note: 上 repeats after the two-part activity 上課.

choices.label: Study Chinese
choices.traditional: 我每天學三個小時的中文。
choices.simplified: 我每天学三个小时的中文。
choices.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān xué sān ge xiǎoshí de Zhōngwén.
choices.english: I study Chinese for three hours every day.
choices.note: Duration + 的 can sit before the thing you study, 中文.

discoveryLab.takeaway: Keep the duration attached to the action—not floating at the end of the whole story.

text.traditional: 我每天工作八個小時。
text.simplified: 我每天工作八个小时。
text.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān gōngzuò bā ge xiǎoshí.
text.english: I work eight hours every day.

text.traditional: 爸爸每天早上運動三十分鐘。
text.simplified: 爸爸每天早上运动三十分钟。
text.pinyin: Bàba měitiān zǎoshang yùndòng sānshí fēnzhōng.
text.english: Dad exercises thirty minutes every morning.

examples.teachingNote: Repeat the verb from the activity.

text.traditional: 我每天跑步跑三十分鐘。
text.simplified: 我每天跑步跑三十分钟。
text.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān pǎobù pǎo sānshí fēnzhōng.
text.english: I run for thirty minutes every day.

examples.teachingNote: Duration + 的 appears before the thing.

text.traditional: 我明天要開六個小時的車。
text.simplified: 我明天要开六个小时的车。
text.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān yào kāi liù ge xiǎoshí de chē.
text.english: I will drive for six hours tomorrow.

LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_FIVE.exercisePreview: Choose a duration shape that fits the activity.

questions.correctFeedback: The duration follows 工作.
The action verb repeats before the duration.

segments.hint: Use 學 + duration + 的 + thing.

tiles.pinyin: xué sān ge xiǎoshí de Zhōngwén
xué Zhōngwén de sān ge xiǎoshí

questions.correctFeedback: Duration + 的 appears before 中文.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 學 + duration + 的 + thing.

LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_FOUR.lessonTitleEnglish: Get on the Internet with a Cell Phone
LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_FOUR.titleEnglish: Start a Countdown with 就要…了
LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_FOUR.learnerPromise: Say that an event is about to happen.
LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_FOUR.explanation: 就要 or 快要 places an event very near. Sentence-final 了 signals that the new situation is arriving.

lessonWorld.title: Get to the museum before it opens
lessonWorld.prompt: It is 8:55. The museum opens at nine.
lessonWorld.traditional: 博物館五分鐘以後就要開門了。
lessonWorld.simplified: 博物馆五分钟以后就要开门了。
lessonWorld.pinyin: Bówùguǎn wǔ fēnzhōng yǐhòu jiù yào kāimén le.
lessonWorld.english: The museum will open in five minutes.

LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_FOUR.pattern: Time clue + 就要／快要 + event + 了

patternRows.english: The doors will open in five minutes.

items.question: I want to say the doors are about to open. 就 or 就要?
items.answer: 就要. 要 carries the “about to” idea; 就 alone means “as early as” or “then.”

right.english: The museum is about to open.

items.question: He is about to go back home. Is 他回國就要了 right?
items.answer: No. Put 就要 before the event and 了 at the very end: 就要 + event + 了.

right.english: He is about to go back to his home country.

items.question: Zhongming is almost here. Where does 快要 go?
items.answer: Before the event: 快要 + event + 了. Never after it.

right.english: Zhongming is almost here.

discoveryLab.title: Match the countdown clock
discoveryLab.description: Choose the sentence whose event is close to the current moment.

choices.label: Doors open
choices.pinyin: Bówùguǎn jiù yào kāimén le.
choices.english: The museum is about to open.
choices.note: The closed doors and near opening time create the countdown.

choices.label: Movie starts
choices.pinyin: Diànyǐng mǎshàng jiù yào kāishǐ le.
choices.english: The movie is about to start.
choices.note: 馬上 strengthens the sense of “very soon.”

choices.label: Almost here
choices.pinyin: Zhōngmíng kuài yào dào le.
choices.english: Zhongming is almost here.
choices.note: 快要 works without 就 in this source pattern.

choices.label: Next month
choices.pinyin: Wǒ xià ge yuè jiù yào huíguó le.
choices.english: I will return home next month.
choices.note: A known approaching change can use the countdown frame.

discoveryLab.takeaway: Look for an approaching change: 就要／快要 + event + 了.

text.traditional: 我下個月就要回國了。
text.simplified: 我下个月就要回国了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ xià ge yuè jiù yào huíguó le.
text.english: I will return home next month.

text.traditional: 他的女朋友明天就要來了，他非常開心。
text.simplified: 他的女朋友明天就要来了，他非常开心。
text.pinyin: Tā de nǚpéngyǒu míngtiān jiù yào lái le, tā fēicháng kāixīn.
text.english: His girlfriend is coming tomorrow; he is very happy.

examples.teachingNote: The source also allows 就 + event + 了 without 要.

text.traditional: 電影馬上就開始了，他怎麼還沒來？
text.simplified: 电影马上就开始了，他怎么还没来？
text.pinyin: Diànyǐng mǎshàng jiù kāishǐ le, tā zěnme hái méi lái?
text.english: The movie is about to start; why is he not here yet?

text.traditional: 圖書館就要關了，你現在去也許太晚了。
text.simplified: 图书馆就要关了，你现在去也许太晚了。
text.pinyin: Túshūguǎn jiù yào guān le, nǐ xiànzài qù yěxǔ tài wǎn le.
text.english: The library is about to close; if you go now, it may be too late.

LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_FOUR.exercisePreview: Choose the event that is approaching now.

questions.correctFeedback: The countdown signal comes before the event.
馬上 and 就要 both point forward to 開始.
快要 comes before the approaching arrival.

LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_ONE.lessonTitleEnglish: Get on the Internet with a Cell Phone
LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_ONE.titleTraditional: 讓動作變得輕鬆、短一點
LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_ONE.titleEnglish: Make an Action Light with V(一)V
LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_ONE.explanation: Repeat a short action word, with or without 一, to make the action feel brief, casual, or low-pressure.

lessonWorld.title: Get to the museum before it opens
lessonWorld.prompt: Guoan sends the museum website. Zhongming takes a quick look.
lessonWorld.english: You can take a quick look first.

LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_ONE.pattern: Action verb + action verb / Action verb + 一 + action verb

patternRows.english: I take a quick look at my phone.

items.question: Does 看看 mean I look two times?
items.answer: No. Doubling the action word makes it short and casual — “for a bit.” 兩次 counts an exact number.

right.english: I want to take a look.

items.question: 聊天 already has two parts. Can I double the whole word?
items.answer: No. Double only the first part: 聊聊天. The rest of the word stays the same.

right.english: Let us chat for a bit.

items.question: I already took a look. Is it 看看了?
items.answer: No. For a finished quick look, put 了 between the two parts: 看了看.

right.english: I took a quick look at my phone.

discoveryLab.title: Short action, not two actions
discoveryLab.description: Repeating the action word softens it. It does not count exactly twice.

choices.label: Quick look
choices.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng kànkan.
choices.english: I want to take a look.
choices.note: 看看 makes the request feel light.

choices.label: Exactly twice
choices.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng kàn liǎng cì.
choices.english: I want to look twice.
choices.note: 兩次 counts an exact number. 看看 does not.

choices.label: Listen a bit
choices.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng tīngting yīnyuè.
choices.english: I want to listen to some music.
choices.note: The action feels relaxed and limited.

choices.label: Casual chat
choices.pinyin: Wǒmen liáo liáotiān ba.
choices.english: Let us chat for a bit.
choices.note: A two-part action like 聊天 can repeat its first part in this shape.

discoveryLab.takeaway: Do not translate the repeated verb as “twice.” Hear it as “for a bit.”

examples.teachingNote: Action verb reduplication softens the tone to indicate doing something casually.

text.traditional: 他週末常去打打球、看看電影。
text.simplified: 他周末常去打打球、看看电影。
text.pinyin: Tā zhōumò cháng qù dǎdǎ qiú, kànkan diànyǐng.
text.english: On weekends he often goes to play ball and watch movies.

examples.teachingNote: Two reduplicated verbs create a relaxed, casual picture of leisure time.

text.traditional: 我平常有空的時候，都在家上上網、玩玩手機。
text.simplified: 我平常有空的时候，都在家上上网、玩玩手机。
text.pinyin: Wǒ píngcháng yǒu kòng de shíhòu, dōu zài jiā shàngshàng wǎng, wánwán shǒujī.
text.english: When I have free time usually, I go online and play on my phone at home.

text.traditional: 媽媽最近心情不太好，我們應該多跟她說說話。
text.simplified: 妈妈最近心情不太好，我们应该多跟她说说话。
text.pinyin: Māma zuìjìn xīnqíng bú tài hǎo, wǒmen yīnggāi duō gēn tā shuō shuōhuà.
text.english: Mom has been in a bad mood lately; we should talk with her more.

examples.teachingNote: Several casual actions can form a relaxed scene.

text.traditional: 上班的休息時間，我常跟同事一起喝喝咖啡、聊聊天。
text.simplified: 上班的休息时间，我常跟同事一起喝喝咖啡、聊聊天。
text.pinyin: Shàngbān de xiūxi shíjiān, wǒ cháng gēn tóngshì yìqǐ hēhe kāfēi, liáo liáotiān.
text.english: During breaks at work, I often have coffee and chat with coworkers.

LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_ONE.exercisePreview: Choose a casual action, not an exact count.

segments.hint: Use the repeated verb for “take a look.”

questions.correctFeedback: 看看 means a quick, low-pressure look.
questions.repairFeedback: Use the repeated verb for “take a look.”

questions.correctFeedback: The action is casual, not counted.
聊聊天 softens the invitation.

LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_THREE.lessonTitleEnglish: Get on the Internet with a Cell Phone
LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_THREE.titleTraditional: 看懂就帶來的「早」和「結果」
LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_THREE.titleEnglish: Read the Time and Result Meanings of 就
LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_THREE.learnerPromise: Recognize something early or a result that follows.
LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_THREE.explanation: In a time scene, 就 can mean earlier than expected. After an instruction or condition, 就 can introduce the result.

lessonWorld.title: Get to the museum before it opens
lessonWorld.prompt: The route is short: walk five minutes and you arrive.
lessonWorld.pinyin: Wǎng yòu zǒu, wǔ fēnzhōng jiù dào le.
lessonWorld.english: Walk right and you will arrive in five minutes.

LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_THREE.pattern: Time + 就 + action / Instruction， 就 + result

patternRows.english: Take a look first, then know.

items.question: He got to work at 8:30, before 9:00. 就 or 才?
items.answer: 就 — “as early as 8:30,” good news. 才 would say “not until 8:30,” which sounds too late.

right.pinyin: Tā bā diǎn bàn jiù dào le.
right.english: He arrived as early as 8:30.

items.question: Where does 就 sit in a result sentence?
items.answer: Right before the result action: 就 + action. Never after it.

right.english: Take a look first, then you will know.

items.question: I woke up at six. Do I need 了 at the end?
items.answer: Yes. An early finished moment uses the pair 就 + action + 了.

right.pinyin: Wǒ liù diǎn jiù qǐchuáng le.
right.english: I got up as early as six.

discoveryLab.title: Two scenes, two jobs for 就
discoveryLab.description: Do not force one English translation. Let the scene reveal the job.

choices.label: Earlier than expected
choices.traditional: 九點上班，我八點半就到了。
choices.simplified: 九点上班，我八点半就到了。
choices.pinyin: Jiǔ diǎn shàngbān, wǒ bā diǎn bàn jiù dào le.
choices.english: Work starts at nine; I arrived as early as 8:30.
choices.note: The expected time is nine. 就 highlights the early arrival.

choices.label: Then you see it
choices.traditional: 往前走，就可以看到博物館。
choices.simplified: 往前走，就可以看到博物馆。
choices.pinyin: Wǎng qián zǒu, jiù kěyǐ kàndào bówùguǎn.
choices.english: Walk forward, then you can see the museum.
choices.note: The first action produces the result after 就.

choices.label: Then it is fine
choices.traditional: 先跟老師請假，就沒問題了。
choices.simplified: 先跟老师请假，就没问题了。
choices.pinyin: Xiān gēn lǎoshī qǐngjià, jiù méi wèntí le.
choices.english: Ask the teacher for leave first; then there is no problem.
choices.note: 就 introduces the result of the solution.

discoveryLab.takeaway: Time scene: sooner than expected. Action scene: then this result follows.

text.traditional: 九點開始上班，可是我每天都八點半就到公司了。
text.simplified: 九点开始上班，可是我每天都八点半就到公司了。
text.pinyin: Jiǔ diǎn kāishǐ shàngbān, kěshì wǒ měitiān dōu bā diǎn bàn jiù dào gōngsī le.
text.english: Work starts at nine, but I arrive at the office by 8:30 every day.

text.traditional: 我今天早上六點就起床了。
text.simplified: 我今天早上六点就起床了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān zǎoshang liù diǎn jiù qǐchuáng le.
text.english: I got up as early as six this morning.

text.traditional: 你往前走，就可以看到那家店了。
text.simplified: 你往前走，就可以看到那家店了。
text.pinyin: Nǐ wǎng qián zǒu, jiù kěyǐ kàndào nà jiā diàn le.
text.english: Walk forward, then you can see the shop.

text.traditional: 你先跟老師請假，就沒問題了吧？
text.simplified: 你先跟老师请假，就没问题了吧？
text.pinyin: Nǐ xiān gēn lǎoshī qǐngjià, jiù méi wèntí le ba?
text.english: Ask the teacher for leave first; then there is no problem.

LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_THREE.exercisePreview: Choose between an early-time signal and a following result.
LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_THREE.exerciseInstruction: Complete the sentence that matches the scene.

questions.correctFeedback: 就 highlights the earlier-than-expected arrival.

segments.hint: Use 就 to open what follows.

questions.correctFeedback: The instruction produces the result.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 就 to open what follows.

segments.hint: Place 就 before the result action.

questions.correctFeedback: 就 introduces the result of checking.
questions.repairFeedback: Place 就 before the result action.

LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_TWO.lessonTitleEnglish: Get on the Internet with a Cell Phone
LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_TWO.titleEnglish: Move from a Start toward a Direction
LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_TWO.learnerPromise: Give a route using a clear start and direction.
LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_TWO.explanation: 從 opens the starting point. 往 opens the direction or destination you move toward.

lessonWorld.title: Get to the museum before it opens
lessonWorld.prompt: The museum is near Guoan’s home.
lessonWorld.pinyin: Cóng wǒ jiā chūqù, wǎng yòu zhuǎn.
lessonWorld.english: Go out from my home and turn right.

LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_TWO.pattern: 從 + start + 往 + direction + action

patternRows.english: Walk from here toward the entrance.
Walk from my home toward the right.

items.question: I want to walk from my home toward the right. Which word is the start?
items.answer: 從 marks where you leave from; 往 marks the way you go. Put 從 first: 從我家往右邊走.

right.pinyin: Cóng wǒ jiā wǎng yòubiān zǒu.
right.english: Walk from my home toward the right.

items.question: Do I need a word before 我家 when I start moving?
items.answer: Yes — 從. It opens the starting point of the movement.

right.pinyin: Cóng wǒ jiā chūqù, wǎng yòu zhuǎn.
right.english: Go out from my home and turn right.

items.question: Can I use 到 instead of 往 for a direction?
items.answer: No. 到 means “arrive at a place.” 往 points the way you move, so use 往 for a direction.

right.english: Walk from here toward the entrance.

routeLab.title: Trace the route arrow
routeLab.description: Choose a route. The left point is 從; the arrow points 往 the destination.

choices.label: To the entrance
choices.pinyin: Cóng zhèlǐ wǎng ménkǒu zǒu.
choices.english: Walk from here toward the entrance.
choices.note: 這裡 is the start; 門口 is the direction.

choices.label: Forward
choices.pinyin: Cóng wǒ jiā wǎng qián zǒu.
choices.english: Walk forward from my home.
choices.note: 往前 gives a direction rather than a named place.

choices.label: Look outside
choices.pinyin: Cóng chuānghu wǎng wài kàn.
choices.english: Look outside from the window.
choices.note: The eyes move from the window toward outside.

routeLab.takeaway: Find the start first. Then follow 往 toward the direction.

text.traditional: 中國字應該從左往右寫，韓國字呢？
text.simplified: 中国字应该从左往右写，韩国字呢？
text.pinyin: Zhōngguó zì yīnggāi cóng zuǒ wǎng yòu xiě, Hánguó zì ne?
text.english: Chinese characters should be written from left to right. What about Korean characters?

text.traditional: 從我房間的窗戶往外看，就可以看到漂亮的風景。
text.simplified: 从我房间的窗户往外看，就可以看到漂亮的风景。
text.pinyin: Cóng wǒ fángjiān de chuānghu wǎng wài kàn, jiù kěyǐ kàndào piàoliang de fēngjǐng.
text.english: Looking outside from my room’s window, you can see beautiful scenery.

examples.teachingNote: A visible landmark gives the direction.

text.traditional: 從這裡往最高的那棟房子走，你會看到兩家百貨公司。
text.simplified: 从这里往最高的那栋房子走，你会看到两家百货公司。
text.pinyin: Cóng zhèlǐ wǎng zuì gāo de nà dòng fángzi zǒu, nǐ huì kàndào liǎng jiā bǎihuò gōngsī.
text.english: Walk from here toward the tallest building, and you will see two department stores.

LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_TWO.exercisePreview: Place 從 at the start and 往 before the direction.

segments.hint: Use 從 + start + 往 + direction.

tiles.meaning: walk from here toward the entrance

questions.correctFeedback: 這裡 is the start; 門口 is the direction.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 從 + start + 往 + direction.

tiles.pinyin: cóng wǒ jiā wǎng yòu zǒu
wǒ jiā cóng yòu wǎng zǒu

questions.correctFeedback: 我家 follows 從; 右 follows 往.
Left is the start; right is the direction.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: Make an Action Light with V(一)V

lessonWorld.title: Get to the museum before it opens
lessonWorld.prompt: Guoan sends the museum website. Zhongming takes a quick look.
lessonWorld.english: You can take a quick look first.

grammarPages.pattern: Action verb + action verb / Action verb + 一 + action verb

patternRows.english: I take a quick look at my phone.

items.question: Does 看看 mean I look two times?
items.answer: No. Doubling the action word makes it short and casual — “for a bit.” 兩次 counts an exact number.

right.english: I want to take a look.

items.question: 聊天 already has two parts. Can I double the whole word?
items.answer: No. Double only the first part: 聊聊天. The rest of the word stays the same.

right.english: Let us chat for a bit.

items.question: I already took a look. Is it 看看了?
items.answer: No. For a finished quick look, put 了 between the two parts: 看了看.

right.english: I took a quick look at my phone.

discoveryLab.title: Short action, not two actions
discoveryLab.description: Repeating the action word softens it. It does not count exactly twice.

choices.label: Quick look
choices.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng kànkan.
choices.english: I want to take a look.
choices.note: 看看 makes the request feel light.

choices.label: Exactly twice
choices.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng kàn liǎng cì.
choices.english: I want to look twice.
choices.note: 兩次 counts an exact number. 看看 does not.

choices.label: Listen a bit
choices.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng tīngting yīnyuè.
choices.english: I want to listen to some music.
choices.note: The action feels relaxed and limited.

choices.label: Casual chat
choices.pinyin: Wǒmen liáo liáotiān ba.
choices.english: Let us chat for a bit.
choices.note: A two-part action like 聊天 can repeat its first part in this shape.

discoveryLab.takeaway: Do not translate the repeated verb as “twice.” Hear it as “for a bit.”

examples.teachingNote: Action verb reduplication softens the tone to indicate doing something casually.

text.traditional: 他週末常去打打球、看看電影。
text.simplified: 他周末常去打打球、看看电影。
text.pinyin: Tā zhōumò cháng qù dǎdǎ qiú, kànkan diànyǐng.
text.english: On weekends he often goes to play ball and watch movies.

examples.teachingNote: Two reduplicated verbs create a relaxed, casual picture of leisure time.

text.traditional: 我平常有空的時候，都在家上上網、玩玩手機。
text.simplified: 我平常有空的时候，都在家上上网、玩玩手机。
text.pinyin: Wǒ píngcháng yǒu kòng de shíhòu, dōu zài jiā shàngshàng wǎng, wánwán shǒujī.
text.english: When I have free time usually, I go online and play on my phone at home.

text.traditional: 媽媽最近心情不太好，我們應該多跟她說說話。
text.simplified: 妈妈最近心情不太好，我们应该多跟她说说话。
text.pinyin: Māma zuìjìn xīnqíng bú tài hǎo, wǒmen yīnggāi duō gēn tā shuō shuōhuà.
text.english: Mom has been in a bad mood lately; we should talk with her more.

examples.teachingNote: Several casual actions can form a relaxed scene.

text.traditional: 上班的休息時間，我常跟同事一起喝喝咖啡、聊聊天。
text.simplified: 上班的休息时间，我常跟同事一起喝喝咖啡、聊聊天。
text.pinyin: Shàngbān de xiūxi shíjiān, wǒ cháng gēn tóngshì yìqǐ hēhe kāfēi, liáo liáotiān.
text.english: During breaks at work, I often have coffee and chat with coworkers.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Choose a casual action, not an exact count.

segments.hint: Use the repeated verb for “take a look.”

questions.correctFeedback: 看看 means a quick, low-pressure look.
questions.repairFeedback: Use the repeated verb for “take a look.”

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Get on the Internet with a Cell Phone
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Move from a Start toward a Direction
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Give a route using a clear start and direction.
grammarPages.explanation: 從 opens the starting point. 往 opens the direction or destination you move toward.

lessonWorld.title: Get to the museum before it opens
lessonWorld.prompt: The museum is near Guoan’s home.
lessonWorld.pinyin: Cóng wǒ jiā chūqù, wǎng yòu zhuǎn.
lessonWorld.english: Go out from my home and turn right.

grammarPages.pattern: 從 + start + 往 + direction + action

patternRows.english: Walk from here toward the entrance.
Walk from my home toward the right.

items.question: I want to walk from my home toward the right. Which word is the start?
items.answer: 從 marks where you leave from; 往 marks the way you go. Put 從 first: 從我家往右邊走.

right.pinyin: Cóng wǒ jiā wǎng yòubiān zǒu.
right.english: Walk from my home toward the right.

items.question: Do I need a word before 我家 when I start moving?
items.answer: Yes — 從. It opens the starting point of the movement.

right.pinyin: Cóng wǒ jiā chūqù, wǎng yòu zhuǎn.
right.english: Go out from my home and turn right.

items.question: Can I use 到 instead of 往 for a direction?
items.answer: No. 到 means “arrive at a place.” 往 points the way you move, so use 往 for a direction.

right.english: Walk from here toward the entrance.

routeLab.title: Trace the route arrow
routeLab.description: Choose a route. The left point is 從; the arrow points 往 the destination.

choices.label: To the entrance
choices.pinyin: Cóng zhèlǐ wǎng ménkǒu zǒu.
choices.english: Walk from here toward the entrance.
choices.note: 這裡 is the start; 門口 is the direction.

choices.label: Forward
choices.pinyin: Cóng wǒ jiā wǎng qián zǒu.
choices.english: Walk forward from my home.
choices.note: 往前 gives a direction rather than a named place.

choices.label: Look outside
choices.pinyin: Cóng chuānghu wǎng wài kàn.
choices.english: Look outside from the window.
choices.note: The eyes move from the window toward outside.

routeLab.takeaway: Find the start first. Then follow 往 toward the direction.

text.traditional: 中國字應該從左往右寫，韓國字呢？
text.simplified: 中国字应该从左往右写，韩国字呢？
text.pinyin: Zhōngguó zì yīnggāi cóng zuǒ wǎng yòu xiě, Hánguó zì ne?
text.english: Chinese characters should be written from left to right. What about Korean characters?

text.traditional: 從我房間的窗戶往外看，就可以看到漂亮的風景。
text.simplified: 从我房间的窗户往外看，就可以看到漂亮的风景。
text.pinyin: Cóng wǒ fángjiān de chuānghu wǎng wài kàn, jiù kěyǐ kàndào piàoliang de fēngjǐng.
text.english: Looking outside from my room’s window, you can see beautiful scenery.

examples.teachingNote: A visible landmark gives the direction.

text.traditional: 從這裡往最高的那棟房子走，你會看到兩家百貨公司。
text.simplified: 从这里往最高的那栋房子走，你会看到两家百货公司。
text.pinyin: Cóng zhèlǐ wǎng zuì gāo de nà dòng fángzi zǒu, nǐ huì kàndào liǎng jiā bǎihuò gōngsī.
text.english: Walk from here toward the tallest building, and you will see two department stores.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Place 從 at the start and 往 before the direction.

segments.hint: Use 從 + start + 往 + direction.

tiles.meaning: walk from here toward the entrance

questions.correctFeedback: 這裡 is the start; 門口 is the direction.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 從 + start + 往 + direction.

tiles.pinyin: cóng wǒ jiā wǎng yòu zǒu
wǒ jiā cóng yòu wǎng zǒu

questions.correctFeedback: 我家 follows 從; 右 follows 往.
Left is the start; right is the direction.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Get on the Internet with a Cell Phone
grammarPages.titleTraditional: 看懂就帶來的「早」和「結果」
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Read the Time and Result Meanings of 就
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Recognize something early or a result that follows.
grammarPages.explanation: In a time scene, 就 can mean earlier than expected. After an instruction or condition, 就 can introduce the result.

lessonWorld.title: Get to the museum before it opens
lessonWorld.prompt: The route is short: walk five minutes and you arrive.
lessonWorld.pinyin: Wǎng yòu zǒu, wǔ fēnzhōng jiù dào le.
lessonWorld.english: Walk right and you will arrive in five minutes.

grammarPages.pattern: Time + 就 + action / Instruction， 就 + result

patternRows.english: Take a look first, then know.

items.question: He got to work at 8:30, before 9:00. 就 or 才?
items.answer: 就 — “as early as 8:30,” good news. 才 would say “not until 8:30,” which sounds too late.

right.pinyin: Tā bā diǎn bàn jiù dào le.
right.english: He arrived as early as 8:30.

items.question: Where does 就 sit in a result sentence?
items.answer: Right before the result action: 就 + action. Never after it.

right.english: Take a look first, then you will know.

items.question: I woke up at six. Do I need 了 at the end?
items.answer: Yes. An early finished moment uses the pair 就 + action + 了.

right.pinyin: Wǒ liù diǎn jiù qǐchuáng le.
right.english: I got up as early as six.

discoveryLab.title: Two scenes, two jobs for 就
discoveryLab.description: Do not force one English translation. Let the scene reveal the job.

choices.label: Earlier than expected
choices.traditional: 九點上班，我八點半就到了。
choices.simplified: 九点上班，我八点半就到了。
choices.pinyin: Jiǔ diǎn shàngbān, wǒ bā diǎn bàn jiù dào le.
choices.english: Work starts at nine; I arrived as early as 8:30.
choices.note: The expected time is nine. 就 highlights the early arrival.

choices.label: Then you see it
choices.traditional: 往前走，就可以看到博物館。
choices.simplified: 往前走，就可以看到博物馆。
choices.pinyin: Wǎng qián zǒu, jiù kěyǐ kàndào bówùguǎn.
choices.english: Walk forward, then you can see the museum.
choices.note: The first action produces the result after 就.

choices.label: Then it is fine
choices.traditional: 先跟老師請假，就沒問題了。
choices.simplified: 先跟老师请假，就没问题了。
choices.pinyin: Xiān gēn lǎoshī qǐngjià, jiù méi wèntí le.
choices.english: Ask the teacher for leave first; then there is no problem.
choices.note: 就 introduces the result of the solution.

discoveryLab.takeaway: Time scene: sooner than expected. Action scene: then this result follows.

text.traditional: 九點開始上班，可是我每天都八點半就到公司了。
text.simplified: 九点开始上班，可是我每天都八点半就到公司了。
text.pinyin: Jiǔ diǎn kāishǐ shàngbān, kěshì wǒ měitiān dōu bā diǎn bàn jiù dào gōngsī le.
text.english: Work starts at nine, but I arrive at the office by 8:30 every day.

text.traditional: 我今天早上六點就起床了。
text.simplified: 我今天早上六点就起床了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān zǎoshang liù diǎn jiù qǐchuáng le.
text.english: I got up as early as six this morning.

text.traditional: 你往前走，就可以看到那家店了。
text.simplified: 你往前走，就可以看到那家店了。
text.pinyin: Nǐ wǎng qián zǒu, jiù kěyǐ kàndào nà jiā diàn le.
text.english: Walk forward, then you can see the shop.

text.traditional: 你先跟老師請假，就沒問題了吧？
text.simplified: 你先跟老师请假，就没问题了吧？
text.pinyin: Nǐ xiān gēn lǎoshī qǐngjià, jiù méi wèntí le ba?
text.english: Ask the teacher for leave first; then there is no problem.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Choose between an early-time signal and a following result.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Complete the sentence that matches the scene.

questions.correctFeedback: 就 highlights the earlier-than-expected arrival.

segments.hint: Use 就 to open what follows.

questions.correctFeedback: The instruction produces the result.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 就 to open what follows.

segments.hint: Place 就 before the result action.

questions.correctFeedback: 就 introduces the result of checking.
questions.repairFeedback: Place 就 before the result action.

dialogue.title: 對話一 · Dialogue 1
dialogue.setting: 國安給中明打電話 · Guoan calls Zhongming

text.traditional: 喂，中明，半個小時以前我寄了一封電子郵件給你，你看到了嗎？
text.simplified: 喂，中明，半个小时以前我寄了一封电子邮件给你，你看到了吗？
text.pinyin: Wèi, Zhōngmíng, bàn ge xiǎoshí yǐqián wǒ jì le yì fēng diànzǐ yóujiàn gěi nǐ, nǐ kàndào le ma?
text.english: Hello, Zhongming, I sent you an email half an hour ago. Have you read it?

text.traditional: 剛剛我的手機網路有點兒問題，不能看電子郵件，你寄的是什麼？
text.simplified: 刚刚我的手机网路有点儿问题，不能看电子邮件，你寄的是什么？
text.pinyin: Gānggāng wǒ de shǒujī wǎnglù yǒudiǎnr wèntí, bù néng kàn diànzǐ yóujiàn, nǐ jì de shì shénme?
text.english: The internet connection on my phone just had a little problem; I couldn’t read your email. What did you send me?

text.traditional: 博物館的網址。下禮拜六老師要帶我們去參觀，你可以先看看。
text.simplified: 博物馆的网址。下礼拜六老师要带我们去参观，你可以先看看。
text.pinyin: Bówùguǎn de wǎngzhǐ. Xià lǐbàiliù lǎoshī yào dài wǒmen qù cānguān, nǐ kěyǐ xiān kànkan.
text.english: I sent you a link for the museum website. The teacher is taking us to visit there next Saturday; you can take a look first.

text.traditional: 好。（看看手機）現在沒問題了，我看到了。
text.simplified: 好。（看看手机）现在没问题了，我看到了。
text.pinyin: Hǎo. (Kànkan shǒujī) Xiànzài méi wèntí le, wǒ kàndào le.
text.english: OK. (Take a look at the phone) There’s no problem now, I’ve read your email.

text.traditional: 網站上有地址，那個地方在我家附近，從我家出去，往右轉，差不多五分鐘就到了。
text.simplified: 网站上有地址，那个地方在我家附近，从我家出去，往右转，差不多五分钟就到了。
text.pinyin: Wǎngzhàn shang yǒu dìzhǐ, nà ge dìfang zài wǒ jiā fùjìn, cóng wǒ jiā chūqù, wǎng yòu zhuǎn, chàbuduō wǔ fēnzhōng jiù dào le.
text.english: There’s the address on the website; that place is close to my house. If you go from my place, you make a right turn, and you’ll be there in just about five minutes.

text.traditional: 我們應該幾點到？
text.simplified: 我们应该几点到？
text.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi jǐ diǎn dào?
text.english: What time should we be there?

text.traditional: 早上九點在博物館門口見，要記得準時到。
text.simplified: 早上九点在博物馆门口见，要记得准时到。
text.pinyin: Zǎoshang jiǔ diǎn zài bówùguǎn ménkǒu jiàn, yào jìde zhǔnshí dào.
text.english: 9 a.m. at the museum gate. Remember to get there on time.

text.traditional: 我們上個星期六去運動的時候，我到得太晚，真不好意思。下個星期我一定會準時。
text.simplified: 我们上个星期六去运动的时候，我到得太晚，真不好意思。下个星期我一定会准时。
text.pinyin: Wǒmen shàng ge xīngqīliù qù yùndòng de shíhou, wǒ dào de tài wǎn, zhēn bù hǎoyìsi. Xià ge xīngqī wǒ yídìng huì zhǔnshí.
text.english: I am sorry for being late when we went exercising last Saturday. I’ll definitely be on time next week.

comprehension.prompt: 從國安家到博物館要多久？
comprehension.hint: Listen for the duration before 就到了.

LESSON_THIRTEEN_PART_TWO.title: Grammar 4–5 · Countdown and duration

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Get on the Internet with a Cell Phone
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Start a Countdown with 就要…了
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that an event is about to happen.
grammarPages.explanation: 就要 or 快要 places an event very near. Sentence-final 了 signals that the new situation is arriving.

lessonWorld.title: Get to the museum before it opens
lessonWorld.prompt: It is 8:55. The museum opens at nine.
lessonWorld.traditional: 博物館五分鐘以後就要開門了。
lessonWorld.simplified: 博物馆五分钟以后就要开门了。
lessonWorld.pinyin: Bówùguǎn wǔ fēnzhōng yǐhòu jiù yào kāimén le.
lessonWorld.english: The museum will open in five minutes.

grammarPages.pattern: Time clue + 就要／快要 + event + 了

patternRows.english: The doors will open in five minutes.

items.question: I want to say the doors are about to open. 就 or 就要?
items.answer: 就要. 要 carries the “about to” idea; 就 alone means “as early as” or “then.”

right.english: The museum is about to open.

items.question: He is about to go back home. Is 他回國就要了 right?
items.answer: No. Put 就要 before the event and 了 at the very end: 就要 + event + 了.

right.english: He is about to go back to his home country.

items.question: Zhongming is almost here. Where does 快要 go?
items.answer: Before the event: 快要 + event + 了. Never after it.

right.english: Zhongming is almost here.

discoveryLab.title: Match the countdown clock
discoveryLab.description: Choose the sentence whose event is close to the current moment.

choices.label: Doors open
choices.pinyin: Bówùguǎn jiù yào kāimén le.
choices.english: The museum is about to open.
choices.note: The closed doors and near opening time create the countdown.

choices.label: Movie starts
choices.pinyin: Diànyǐng mǎshàng jiù yào kāishǐ le.
choices.english: The movie is about to start.
choices.note: 馬上 strengthens the sense of “very soon.”

choices.label: Almost here
choices.pinyin: Zhōngmíng kuài yào dào le.
choices.english: Zhongming is almost here.
choices.note: 快要 works without 就 in this source pattern.

choices.label: Next month
choices.pinyin: Wǒ xià ge yuè jiù yào huíguó le.
choices.english: I will return home next month.
choices.note: A known approaching change can use the countdown frame.

discoveryLab.takeaway: Look for an approaching change: 就要／快要 + event + 了.

text.traditional: 我下個月就要回國了。
text.simplified: 我下个月就要回国了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ xià ge yuè jiù yào huíguó le.
text.english: I will return home next month.

text.traditional: 他的女朋友明天就要來了，他非常開心。
text.simplified: 他的女朋友明天就要来了，他非常开心。
text.pinyin: Tā de nǚpéngyǒu míngtiān jiù yào lái le, tā fēicháng kāixīn.
text.english: His girlfriend is coming tomorrow; he is very happy.

examples.teachingNote: The source also allows 就 + event + 了 without 要.

text.traditional: 電影馬上就開始了，他怎麼還沒來？
text.simplified: 电影马上就开始了，他怎么还没来？
text.pinyin: Diànyǐng mǎshàng jiù kāishǐ le, tā zěnme hái méi lái?
text.english: The movie is about to start; why is he not here yet?

text.traditional: 圖書館就要關了，你現在去也許太晚了。
text.simplified: 图书馆就要关了，你现在去也许太晚了。
text.pinyin: Túshūguǎn jiù yào guān le, nǐ xiànzài qù yěxǔ tài wǎn le.
text.english: The library is about to close; if you go now, it may be too late.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Choose the event that is approaching now.

questions.correctFeedback: The countdown signal comes before the event.
馬上 and 就要 both point forward to 開始.
快要 comes before the approaching arrival.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Get on the Internet with a Cell Phone
grammarPages.titleTraditional: 量出一個動作做了多久
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say how long an action lasts.
grammarPages.explanation: Duration follows the action. With some activities that pair an action word with a thing, Chinese repeats the action word or uses duration + 的 before the thing.

lessonWorld.title: Measure the whole journey
lessonWorld.prompt: The group waits ten minutes and visits for three hours.
lessonWorld.traditional: 我們排隊排十分鐘，參觀三個小時。
lessonWorld.simplified: 我们排队排十分钟，参观三个小时。
lessonWorld.pinyin: Wǒmen páiduì pái shí fēnzhōng, cānguān sān ge xiǎoshí.
lessonWorld.english: We wait in line for ten minutes and visit for three hours.

items.question: I slept three hours. Can I say 我睡覺三個小時?
items.answer: No. A two-part action word needs its first part again: 睡了三個小時的覺 (or 睡覺睡三個小時).

right.pinyin: Wǒ shuì le sān ge xiǎoshí de jiào.
right.english: I slept for three hours.

items.question: Why does 睡 repeat AFTER 睡覺, not inside it?
items.answer: For duration, repeat the first action word after the whole word: 睡覺睡十分鐘. 睡睡覺 would mean “sleep a bit” — not a count of time.

right.english: I sleep for ten minutes.

items.question: I study Chinese for three hours. Where does the time go?
items.answer: With a thing after the action, use duration + 的 + thing: 學三個小時的中文.

right.pinyin: Wǒ xué sān ge xiǎoshí de Zhōngwén.
right.english: I study Chinese for three hours.

discoveryLab.title: Attach the clock to the action
discoveryLab.description: Start with the simplest shape, then watch what happens when the activity also names a thing.

choices.label: Work
choices.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān gōngzuò bā ge xiǎoshí.
choices.english: I work eight hours every day.
choices.note: A simple action can take duration directly.

choices.label: Sleep
choices.traditional: 我每天睡覺睡七個小時。
choices.simplified: 我每天睡觉睡七个小时。
choices.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān shuìjiào shuì qī ge xiǎoshí.
choices.english: I sleep seven hours every day.
choices.note: The action word from 睡覺 repeats before the duration.

choices.label: Class
choices.traditional: 我明天要上課上三個小時。
choices.simplified: 我明天要上课上三个小时。
choices.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān yào shàngkè shàng sān ge xiǎoshí.
choices.english: I will attend class for three hours tomorrow.
choices.note: 上 repeats after the two-part activity 上課.

choices.label: Study Chinese
choices.traditional: 我每天學三個小時的中文。
choices.simplified: 我每天学三个小时的中文。
choices.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān xué sān ge xiǎoshí de Zhōngwén.
choices.english: I study Chinese for three hours every day.
choices.note: Duration + 的 can sit before the thing you study, 中文.

discoveryLab.takeaway: Keep the duration attached to the action—not floating at the end of the whole story.

text.traditional: 我每天工作八個小時。
text.simplified: 我每天工作八个小时。
text.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān gōngzuò bā ge xiǎoshí.
text.english: I work eight hours every day.

text.traditional: 爸爸每天早上運動三十分鐘。
text.simplified: 爸爸每天早上运动三十分钟。
text.pinyin: Bàba měitiān zǎoshang yùndòng sānshí fēnzhōng.
text.english: Dad exercises thirty minutes every morning.

examples.teachingNote: Repeat the verb from the activity.

text.traditional: 我每天跑步跑三十分鐘。
text.simplified: 我每天跑步跑三十分钟。
text.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān pǎobù pǎo sānshí fēnzhōng.
text.english: I run for thirty minutes every day.

examples.teachingNote: Duration + 的 appears before the thing.

text.traditional: 我明天要開六個小時的車。
text.simplified: 我明天要开六个小时的车。
text.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān yào kāi liù ge xiǎoshí de chē.
text.english: I will drive for six hours tomorrow.

dialogue.title: 對話二 · Dialogue 2
dialogue.setting: 在博物館門口 · At the museum gate

text.traditional: 博物館五分鐘以後就要開門了，大家都到了吧？
text.simplified: 博物馆五分钟以后就要开门了，大家都到了吧？
text.pinyin: Bówùguǎn wǔ fēnzhōng yǐhòu jiù yào kāimén le, dàjiā dōu dào le ba?
text.english: The museum will be open after five minutes. Is everyone here already?

text.traditional: 中明說他快要到了。
text.simplified: 中明说他快要到了。
text.pinyin: Zhōngmíng shuō tā kuài yào dào le.
text.english: Zhongming said he’ll be here soon.

text.traditional: 老師，我們要不要先去排隊買票？
text.simplified: 老师，我们要不要先去排队买票？
text.pinyin: Lǎoshī, wǒmen yào bu yào xiān qù páiduì mǎi piào?
text.english: Teacher, should we get in line to buy tickets first?

text.traditional: 差不多需要排十分鐘的隊，那好吧，我們先去排隊。
text.simplified: 差不多需要排十分钟的队，那好吧，我们先去排队。
text.pinyin: Chàbuduō xūyào pái shí fēnzhōng de duì, nà hǎo ba, wǒmen xiān qù páiduì.
text.english: It takes about ten minutes to line up. Alright, let’s get in line to buy tickets first.

text.traditional: 今天我們打算參觀三個小時，會有人給我們介紹。進去以後，記得要安靜，不可以說話說得太大聲。
text.simplified: 今天我们打算参观三个小时，会有人给我们介绍。进去以后，记得要安静，不可以说话说得太大声。
text.pinyin: Jīntiān wǒmen dǎsuàn cānguān sān ge xiǎoshí, huì yǒu rén gěi wǒmen jièshào. Jìnqù yǐhòu, jìde yào ānjìng, bù kěyǐ shuōhuà shuō de tài dàshēng.
text.english: We plan to visit for three hours today. There will be someone introducing the museum for us. After you enter, remember to keep quiet. You can’t speak loudly.

text.traditional: 老師，我剛剛先用手機上網看了很多有趣的圖片，真想馬上就看到博物館裡的東西。
text.simplified: 老师，我刚刚先用手机上网看了很多有趣的图片，真想马上就看到博物馆里的东西。
text.pinyin: Lǎoshī, wǒ gānggāng xiān yòng shǒujī shàngwǎng kàn le hěn duō yǒuqù de túpiàn, zhēn xiǎng mǎshàng jiù kàndào bówùguǎn lǐ de dōngxi.
text.english: Teacher, I just used my cell phone to look for some information on the internet, and I saw many interesting pictures. I want to see what they have in the museum right away.

text.traditional: 我知道你非常喜歡歷史，我想你今天一定會很開心。
text.simplified: 我知道你非常喜欢历史，我想你今天一定会很开心。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào nǐ fēicháng xǐhuan lìshǐ, wǒ xiǎng nǐ jīntiān yídìng huì hěn kāixīn.
text.english: I know you like history very much. I think you’ll enjoy it a lot today.

text.traditional: 我也在網路上找了很多文章，那些介紹和故事都非常有趣。
text.simplified: 我也在网路上找了很多文章，那些介绍和故事都非常有趣。
text.pinyin: Wǒ yě zài wǎnglù shang zhǎo le hěn duō wénzhāng, nàxiē jièshào hé gùshi dōu fēicháng yǒuqù.
text.english: I also found many articles on the internet. Those introductions and stories are very fascinating.

text.traditional: 那如果大家有問題就可以問你了。
text.simplified: 那如果大家有问题就可以问你了。
text.pinyin: Nà rúguǒ dàjiā yǒu wèntí jiù kěyǐ wèn nǐ le.
text.english: If anyone has questions, they can ask you then.

text.traditional: 要是我知道，一定會告訴大家！
text.simplified: 要是我知道，一定会告诉大家！
text.pinyin: Yàoshi wǒ zhīdào, yídìng huì gàosu dàjiā!
text.english: If I know the answers, I’ll tell them for sure!

text.traditional: （往前看）中明來了！
text.simplified: （往前看）中明来了！
text.pinyin: (Wǎng qián kàn) Zhōngmíng lái le!
text.english: (Look forward) Here comes Zhongming!

text.traditional: 好，我們進去參觀吧。
text.simplified: 好，我们进去参观吧。
text.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒmen jìnqù cānguān ba.
text.english: Okay! Let’s get in to visit.
